data.name: Iron Dusk Path of Honor
data.detailed_description:
Iron Dusk: Path of Honor is a gripping 2D/3D hybrid medieval action-adventure where honor is forged through fire, steel, and sacrifice. Step into the boots of a fallen knight as you embark on a cinematic journey across a war-torn kingdom, haunted by betrayal and bound by destiny.

Once a celebrated hero, you now fight to reclaim your name in a land overrun by cultist tyrants, ruthless pirates, and shadowy forces. Cast into the depths, forced into arenas, lost at sea, and hunted by ancient evils, your path to redemption winds through arena combat, treacherous towns, and storm-wracked shores.

⚔️ Features

Epic Story-Driven Campaign – Follow a fully narrated, chapter-based storyline with dramatic voiceover and cinematic presentation. From dungeons to duels, each act builds toward a climactic final confrontation.

Hybrid Visual Style – Traverse a stylized world where 2D art blends seamlessly with 3D combat arenas and environments.

Skill-Based Combat – Slash, block, and strike with precision in reactive real-time battles. Right-click for light attacks, left-click for heavy blows, and time your parries to survive deadly encounters.

Morality and Choices – Lie, gamble, or fight your way forward. Outwit pirates in games of Liar’s Dice or take your chances with your sword.

A World of Danger and Wonder – From outlaw ports to Viking cult villages, the world of Iron Dusk is rich with atmosphere, mystery, and danger.

Dynamic Encounters – Face brutal arena fights, bar brawls, sea storms, and siege warfare as you climb from disgrace to glory.

🛡️ Will You Rise?

Fight for your kingdom. Reclaim your honor. Face the cult. Confront the king. The dusk is falling—but from the ashes, heroes rise.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 590 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
